scripts.dev: if [ -t 1 ]; then export FORCE_COLOR=1 CARGO_TERM_COLOR=always; fi && bun run --parallel dev:server dev:ui
scripts.dev:server: FIXPUNKT_DATA_DIR=.dev FIXPUNKT_LISTEN=127.0.0.1:8080 FIXPUNKT_DEV_UI=http://localhost:5173 FIXPUNKT_USER=admin FIXPUNKT_PASSWORD=adminadmin cargo run -p fixpunkt-server
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd ui typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.e2e: bun run build && cargo build -p fixpunkt-server && bun --bun playwright test --project=setup --project=desktop --project=phone
scripts.docs:screenshots: bun run build && cargo build -p fixpunkt-server && DOKU_SCREENSHOTS=1 bun --bun playwright test --project=screenshots
